addressHelp: IP address or hostname of the Hyperion server
portHelp: TCP port for the JSON API (default: 19444)
priorityHelp: Default priority for color and effect commands (1-999)
originHelp: Origin identifier sent with Hyperion.ng commands
tokenHelp: Authentication token for Hyperion.ng (leave empty if not required)
instanceHelp: Instance number to control (0 = first instance); re-selected after every reconnect
pollIntervalHelp: Seconds between serverinfo polls for Classic Hyperion
